extracted text: The paper studies the effect of two-step aging on AA2219 direct chill (DC) cast alloy. The heat treatments involved solutionizing at 540°C for 8h, followed by either water quenching (cooling rate 120°C/s) or air quenching (cooling rate 0.2°C/s), and then various aging treatments. The best two-step aging treatment was 120°C/36h+190°C/8h (condition A9), which increased hardness, YS, and UTS by 27%, 46%, and 15% respectively compared to one-step aging at 190°C/8h (condition A2). Detailed heat treatments are described in Table 3: W1 (water quenched), W2 (water quenched + 190°C/8h), A1 (air quenched), A2 (air quenched + 190°C/8h), A9 (air quenched + 120°C/36h+190°C/8h).
